concerns.text: The plan schedules a hierarchical bootstrap with 10 000 iterations for each species (Phase 6). On the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ≤7 GB RAM, 6 h limit) this may exceed the allowed runtime, especially when training 20–50 species with three SDM algorithms each. Provide a fallback (e.g., reduce iterations to 5 000 or allow early termination based on elapsed time) and include a runtime estimate to ensure the pipeline stays within the 360‑minute budget.
